questions.explanation: The call in a static main has no object to borrow, so the header must be static, it must take one int then one String to match the two values in that order, and it must print the hyphenated form the stem asks for, which the first header does. Reversing the parameter types puts a text where the call supplies a number, leaving one parameter out contradicts a call that supplies two, and returning an int from a call used as a bare statement is legal but prints nothing at all, so the expected output never appears.
questions.hint: Read the call in main first: how many values, of what types, and in what order?
questions.learningObjective: write a method header that satisfies a call site exactly
